hook.name: FoundryHookV4
hook.description: Shared fee hook for all Foundry launchpad pools on Robinhood Chain. Takes ETH-denominated fees (1.00–1.25% scaled by pre-trade market cap), splits them between creator and protocol with configurable payout wallets, enforces anti-snipe restrictions during the launch window, blocks outside liquidity additions pre-graduation, and supports a graduation mechanism after which the hook fee drops to zero.
